answer: Farming becomes a pearl bet on surviving 49 epochs of grading, and every prism settlement recomputes the karst schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 11 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 49 epochs rather than arriving at once. That is 22 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
